atomic_facts.fact: Greg Abel became Chief Executive Officer of Berkshire Hathaway on January 1, 2026.
The appointment resulted from a unanimous Board of Directors vote on May 4, 2025 to make Abel President and CEO effective January 1, 2026.
Warren Buffett stepped down as CEO in connection with the transition while remaining Chairman of the Board.
Warren Buffett ceased as CEO of Berkshire Hathaway on January 1, 2026.
Warren Buffett remained Chairman of the Board after stepping down as CEO, until September 18, 2026.
On September 18, 2026, Warren Buffett was named Chairman Emeritus, effective immediately, while remaining a director.
Howard G. Buffett was elected Chairman of the Board of Berkshire Hathaway.
Howard G. Buffett's election as Chairman was effective September 18, 2026, announced as effective immediately in the press release dated that day.
Greg Abel did not become chairman of Berkshire Hathaway.
The September 18, 2026 press release identifies Greg Abel as Chief Executive Officer.
No evidence indicates a change in Abel's CEO title between September 18 and October 1, 2026.
